correctness.rationale: For strictly alpha-stable 0<alpha<2 and fixed interior launch x, the one-large-jump exit law gives P(tau<=t)=A t+o(t) and exponentially tilted marked success Q_B(r)~nu(B-x)/r. IID restart excursions give N geometric with success A/r and an exact joint transform; rH converges to Exp(1) independently of side and Pareto excess. Failed clocks have conditional rD mean 1+O(1/r), variance→1 and bounded exponential moments; since N/r⇒E Exp(A), a random-index characteristic function gives (N/r,sqrt r(sum D_j-N/r))⇒(E,sqrt E Z), with sqrt r H negligible. Gaussian mixing over E yields characteristic function A/(A+xi²/2), i.e. Laplace. Independent exact competing-exponential benchmark confirms transform and characteristic function convergence but does not prove the stable Lévy marked small-time lemma.
residual_risks: The Lévy process must be strictly stable with 0<alpha<2, and neither r→infinity jointly with boundary distance→0 nor alpha→2 is covered.
